root_cause.text: The BPF verifier's `adjust_reg_min_max_vals()` function performs in-place modification of the destination register before delta tracking, which causes it to read the incorrect post-modification value when the source and destination registers point to the same `bpf_reg_state` structure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff in `kernel/bpf/verifier.c` adds the check `!(BPF_SRC(insn->code) == BPF_X && insn->src_reg == insn->dst_reg)` to skip delta tracking when the source and destination registers are identical, preventing the verifier from using the modified register state to calculate an incorrect delta.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a guard condition to prevent incorrect register state tracking when a register is added to or subtracted from itself in the BPF verifier.
intent_record.what: Added a check to exclude instructions where the source and destination registers are the same (rX = rX + rX) from the constant-offset register adjustment logic.
intent_record.how: Prevents the BPF verifier from incorrectly tracking register state and scalar propagation when a register with an ID is added to or subtracted from itself.

candidates.rationale: The condition lacks a check to ensure that the source and destination registers are not the same (i.e., dst_reg != src_reg). When they are the same, in-place modification of dst_reg also modifies src_reg, causing incorrect delta tracking.
